svg.text: 3-Kelvin-sense ratiometric, ±2.5 V polarity-reversed excitation, MUX-switched R_ref bank.
R_dut = R_ref × (Vx3 − Vx4) / (Vx5 − Vx3). V_exc and switch/MUX R_on cancel out of the result.

g.text: • ADA4522-2 V+ / V−: source from DiffVM ±5 V rails via filtered tap (C2 100 nF at each pin).
• 2× MUX36S08 V+ / V−: same ±5 V rails. EN tied to V+. VL tied to V+ (or 3.3 V if logic level-matched).
• TMUX7234 V+ / V−: same rails. EN tied to V+.
• 100 nF X7R decoupling at every IC supply pin (not all shown).
• Star-ground at TB1.F−; route R_ref_lo bus short and direct.
1. R1, R2 must be matched ≤2 ppm tracking (Vishay VHP100 pair); mount in thermal contact.
2. R_ref bank: Vishay Z-foil or Caddock USR; ≤2 ppm/°C, ≤0.01 % initial tolerance.
3. Each RR[n] LEFT pin tied to BOTH U2.S[n] and U3.S[n] (= Rt[n] bus). RIGHT pin tied to R_ref_lo bus.
